action.objective: Verify d5b4 (Nxb4) at full depth with the reserved verification budget, checking safety against Black's best replies.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search left d5b4 as the only exact top candidate (1481), with other rows only upper bounds. Nxb4 wins a bishop for the knight, removing Black's active dark-squared bishop, and the PV line b4a6 b7a6 trades knight for the a6 knight. Reserved verification targets this move with 2000 nodes.
